name: HostAd
tagline: Buying outdoor advertising still means calling an agency, waiting for a manager, visiting an office to pick a billboard, and signing paper contracts
description: Buying outdoor advertising still means calling an agency, waiting for a manager, visiting an office to pick a billboard, and signing paper contracts. HostAd replaces all of that with a single map. Advertisers open hostad.io, pick the screens they want — in cafés, salons, barbershops, coworkings and other high-traffic venues — choose the months, and launch a campaign in minutes.
